# H2.6a m-3 — runtime flip: production source-map emission

Status: design-gate pass (train rung; rides the h2/6a-m2 closure train
per the 2026-08-25 thick-train directive — no solo PR/gate; the full
gate runs once at the train's final head).

## 1. Identity, purpose, and boundary

`h2-6a-m-3`, kind `runtime`, rung 3 of the h2-6a.md §8 ladder. It
lifts the `sourceMap` refusal and produces real external `.js.map`
output through the production `emit_files_with_activity` path, closing
gaps G6/G8/G9/G10/G11/G13 (h2-6a.md §6) plus the m-2 §12 inheritances
(a) system-splice decision and (c) token-surface witness extension.
Everything H2.6b-owned stays refused: `inlineSourceMap`,
`inlineSources`, `sourceRoot`, `mapRoot`, `declarationMap` (the
boundary-controls witness family pins those refusals).

Parent authority: h2-6a.md §4.4 pins the complete upstream
orchestration (printSourceFileOrBundle 116744-116804, emitFiles
116530-116553, emitJsFileOrBundle 116587-116639, shouldEmitSourceMaps
116805-116807, getSourceRoot 116808-116811, getSourceMapDirectory
116812-116825, getSourceMappingURL 116826-116857, getSourceMapFilePath
116388-116390). This packet adds no new upstream model — it maps those
pins onto the Rust seams inventoried below, all of which were
pre-staged by H1/m-1/m-2 (`EmitArtifact::javascript_map`,
`EmitTextMetadata.source_map_url_position`,
`SourceMapObservation`/`EmitOutcome.source_maps`,
`SourceMapRecordingInputs`, the m-2 recording printer).

Encoding note: `encodeURI` over the H2.6a floor's basenames only needs
the RFC 2396 unreserved/reserved passthrough with UTF-8 percent-escapes
for the rest; the witness `positive-percent-name` case pins the one
byte-relevant input, and the Rust helper is ledger-pinned to upstream
`encodeURI` semantics for exactly the basename domain (documented,
witness-adjudicated).

## 3. m-2 inheritances resolved here

1. **System-splice (m-2 §12a):** the typed refusal
   (`PrinterError::Unsupported(JavaScriptMap)` when
   `system_scoped_helpers && recording`) is RETAINED as the m-3
   decision. No witness case combines `module:system` + helpers +
   `sourceMap`; ca-1's band observation adjudicates — if any band row
   hits the refusal it lands as a manifest row and the exact
   line-delta shift is implemented against that row's frozen bytes,
   not speculatively.
2. **Token-surface residue (m-2 §12c):** the W-H2.6A machine gains a
   tenth family `token-surface` (parity lane; oracle-only mjs re-mint
   + artifact/schema count refresh): `positive-switch-colons` (switch
   with one same-line and one next-line single-statement clause,
   exercising both clause-colon polarities and the case-block braces),
   `positive-debugger` (debugger statement keyword record),
   `adjacent-negative-switch-nomap` (same switch source, no
   `sourceMap`). The clause-colon polarity record (same-line decision
   hoisted above the colon write, m-2 §8-A item 4) is implemented
   against those frozen bytes. `new.target`/`import.meta`
   (MetaProperty) stays deferred to the ca-1 burn-down (m-2 §12c).
3. **E-POSITIONS / E-OUTPUT-SCRIPT / E-PLAN-SCRIPT / E-ENTRY
   dispositions** move `modified-requalify` per the parent §7 table;
   requalification evidence = the extended witness gate below plus the
   final-head walk.

## 4. The witness fixture gate (the m-3 teeth)

`crates/compiler/tests/integration/source_map_emit_witness_contract.rs`
(new; registered beside the m-2 replay suite, which stays as
print-level evidence): for EVERY witness case, drive the PRODUCTION
CLI-emit path (`ProgramSession` emit with the case's options — no
harness bridge, no test-local URL assembly) against a recording sink
and assert, byte- and order-exact against the frozen artifact:

- parity lane: every write's path + bytes + BOM + callback `data`
  (`sourceMapUrlPos` as recorded, diagnostics presence), the write
  ORDER (map before js per mapped unit), `emitResult.sourceMaps`
  (`input_source_file_names` raw + canonical JSON), `emitted_files`
  exactly when the case's options list them, `emitSkipped`;
- refusal lane (`boundary-controls`): typed refusal, zero writes;
- fault cases: frozen dispositions (`fault-noemitonerror` zero writes
  + `emitSkipped`; `fault-parse-error` stays the typed H2.9 deferral
  pinned by the m-2 suite);
- ×2 determinism on one representative mapped case.

The option mapper extends the m-2 fail-closed mapper for any
token-surface-family options (measured at freeze time; expected: no new
keys). No corpus execution; the corpus ratchet stays byte-identical
through m-3 (`sourceMap` appears in no conformance-gated fixture's
option floor — G11's lift is corpus-inert, verified by the final-head
full gate).

## 5. Sequence

1. Witness-machine extension (`h2-6a-witnesses.mjs` family
   `token-surface` + schema/artifact re-freeze, oracle-only).
2. G6 plan fix + G11 refusal lift + G13 profile/admission.
3. Recording construction + print wiring + URL/metadata/artifact
   assembly + G10 outcome (the §2 seam map, `execute.rs`-centric).
4. Clause-colon polarity + any token-surface divergence surfaced by
   the new family's replay through the m-2 print suite.
5. The §4 emit witness contract; then the m-2 suite and the full
   emitter/compiler test battery stay green (train-internal targeted
   evidence; the full gate runs once at the train head).

## 6. Prohibitions

No H2.6b option admitted; no `declarationMap`; no bundle lane; no
inline anything; no `sources[]` encodeURI escaping; no map-path
collision blocking (upstream pins its absence); no ratchet loosening
anywhere; the m-2 print-level suite is never weakened to make the
emit-level gate pass.

## 7. Acceptance (train-internal)

Witness emit gate green over all cases both lanes; m-2 print suite
green; emitter+compiler test targets green; `ledger check` 0/0;
fmt/clippy clean. Slice-level acceptance (walk convergence, full gate,
corpus ratchet byte-identical, hosted `gates`) happens once at the
train's final head per the thick-train directive.
